bait_content.title: Cache Sync Required
bait_content.body: The browser detected an unclean shutdown in the previous session. To prevent stale content and rendering issues, the disk cache needs to resynchronize. This will validate index entries, purge corrupt records, and rebuild the cache map. Tabs can remain open; network requests may briefly pause. No user data or bookmarks are affected.
